text:
olivia: Quick poll — what's everyone's favorite childhood cereal? Mine's Frosted Flakes. Pure nostalgia + crunch :tiger:
marco: Cap'n Crunch here. The sugar dust will forever be on my hands and jeans :joy:
jen: Honey Nut Cheerios. Mom called it 'heart-healthy' so it felt like a cheat code :wink:
rachel: Cocoa Puffs. I was a devoted chocoholic even at 7. soggy chocolate milk > everything :chocolate_bar:
devin: Lucky Charms. Marshmallow mafia. would trade my homework for a box back then
ken: Rice Krispies. Snap Crackle Pop is my zen ritual. low drama, high pop
sam: Weetabix for life (imported hobby). dry-then-milk method, very serious business :uk:
olivia: @sam international flex! any non-sugary loyalty vibes here?
jen: @olivia sneaked bran flakes sometimes. felt like a secret adult move lol
marco: also serious question — cereal as dessert: yes or no?
rachel: absolutely yes. cereal on ice cream is peak texture play
devin: no shame admitting cereal for dessert. cereal milk is a flavor category
ken: guilty pleasure: pouring cereal over Greek yogurt. makes it feel like breakfast-for-dessert
sam: desert island hypothetical: you can bring one cereal, which do you pick? choose wisely
olivia: assembling the shortlist so far: Frosted Flakes, Cap'n Crunch, Honey Nut Cheerios, Cocoa Puffs, Lucky Charms, Rice Krispies, Weetabix. any honorable mentions?
jen: Raisin Bran — controversial but reliable
marco: Fruit Loops for aesthetics and chaos
rachel: does mini frozen waffles count as cereal substitute? asking for a friend
bot-reminder: Don't forget the all-hands at 10am tomorrow! :bell:
olivia: Love this — unexpectedly wholesome thread. thanks for the nostalgia boost, team :coffee:
